description: Source code for auto neighbor addition feature in a wireless LAN management system, including functions to add or delete neighbor access points, configure settings, and handle related events.

methods.name: s_setNeighbourAP
methods.description: Adds a specific access point to the neighbor list of a target access point.

methods.name: s_delNeighbourAP
methods.description: Removes a specific access point from the neighbor list of a target access point.

methods.name: wld_autoNeighAdd_vapSetDelNeighbourAP
methods.description: Sets or deletes neighbor access points for a given access point.

methods.name: wld_autoNeighAdd_radioSetDelNeighbourAP
methods.description: Sets or deletes neighbor access points for all access points associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_autoNeighAdd_vapReloadNeighbourAP
methods.description: Reloads neighbor access points for a specific access point by removing and re-adding it.

methods.name: s_setNeighbourBands_pwf
methods.description: Updates the neighbor bands configuration parameter.

methods.name: s_setEnable_pwf
methods.description: Enables or disables the auto neighbor addition feature.

methods.name: _wld_autoNeighAddition_setConf_ocf
methods.description: Handles configuration events for the auto neighbor addition feature.
